problems.title: Certificate redhat-ods-applications/odh-observability-webhook-cert reports Ready, but its Secret odh-observability-webhook-cert is missing: cert-manager is installed but its controller is not running
problems.description: cert-manager keeps Secret odh-observability-webhook-cert from this Certificate. The Secret is gone but the Certificate still says Ready, because no cert-manager controller runs to notice. Until it is issued again, pods that mount the Secret stay in ContainerCreating, and webhooks whose CA it injects (cert-manager.io/inject-ca-from) have no serving certificate. Those symptoms are listed here instead of as separate problems.
evidence: Certificate redhat-ods-applications/odh-observability-webhook-cert (Secret odh-observability-webhook-cert): Ready=True (Ready): Certificate is up to date and has not expired
Ready=True is stale: Secret odh-observability-webhook-cert does not exist (pods fail to mount it), and only a running cert-manager would update the condition
No cert-manager controller Deployment (labels app.kubernetes.io/name=cert-manager or app=cert-manager) has an available pod: cert-manager/cert-manager (0 of 0 available)
cert-manager Operator for Red Hat OpenShift is installed (CSV cert-manager-operator/cert-manager-operator.v1.20.1 Succeeded)
Operator Deployment cert-manager-operator/cert-manager-operator-controller-manager: 0 of 0 available (scaled to 0, so nothing restores the controller)
Cannot start without Secret odh-observability-webhook-cert: Pod redhat-ods-applications/odh-observability-abc
CA injected from it (cert-manager.io/inject-ca-from): ValidatingWebhookConfiguration odh-observability-webhook
Also explains: 1 RHOAI webhook configuration calls a Service that cannot serve it
Also explains: odh-observability: 1 pod stuck in ContainerCreating: secret "odh-observability-webhook-cert" not found
problems.fix: Bring the cert-manager Operator for Red Hat OpenShift back (commands below); it then restarts the cert-manager controller, which issues the Secret again, and the pods start on their own.
